title: Return to Sport After ACL Surgery — Criteria, Not the Calendar

hook.en: Many athletes go back to sport at six months and tear the graft again. Learn which tests and criteria show a knee is ready, and why time alone is not enough.
hook.ur: Bohat se khilari chhe mahine mein khel mein wapas aate hain aur graft dobara tor lete hain. Seekhein ke kaun se tests aur mayaar batate hain ke knee taiyar hai, aur sirf waqt kaafi kyun nahi.

goal.en: By the end, you'll build a staged return-to-sport plan after ACL reconstruction, use strength and hop tests with limb symmetry, add psychological readiness and movement quality, and explain why later and criteria-based return lowers re-injury.
goal.ur: End tak aap ACL reconstruction ke baad marhale war return-to-sport plan banayenge, limb symmetry ke saath strength aur hop tests istemal karenge, psychological readiness aur movement quality shamil karenge, aur samjhayenge ke der se aur mayaar par wapsi dobara chot kam karti hai.

text.en: Return to sport is a **process in three steps**: return to **participation** (training), return to **sport** (matches) and return to **performance** (the athlete's old level). Passing the calendar is not a test. Athletes who return **before nine months**, or who **fail** strength and hop tests, are at much higher risk of a second ACL injury. The decision uses **criteria**: strength, hop performance, movement quality, psychological readiness and time.
text.ur: Return to sport **teen marhalon ka amal** hai: **hissa lena** (training), **khel** (matches) aur **performance** (khilari ki purani satah) par wapsi. Tareekh guzarna test nahi. Jo khilari **nau mahine se pehle** wapas aate hain, ya strength aur hop tests mein **fail** hote hain unhein doosri ACL chot ka bohat zyada khatra hota hai. Faisla **mayaar** par hota hai: taaqat, hop performance, movement quality, psychological readiness aur waqt.

text.en: Think of return to sport as **a driving test**, not a birthday. You do not get a licence because you reached seventeen; you pass a set of skills first. The graft takes many months to mature and the brain and muscles need time to rebuild trust. Passing the test is what makes the road safe.
text.ur: Return to sport ko **driving test** samjhein, salgirah nahi. Aap ko licence sattarah saal ke hone par nahi milta; pehle chand maharaton ka test paas karna parta hai. Graft ko pukhta hone mein kai mahine lagte hain aur dimagh aur muscles ko bharosa dobara banane ka waqt chahiye. Test paas karna sarak ko mehfooz banata hai.

steps.title: Set the stages
steps.detail: Plan stages: protection and range, strength, running, change of direction, sport-specific drills and then contact or matches. Move on when the criteria for the stage are met, not by date alone. || Marhale tay karein

steps.title: Measure strength
steps.detail: Test quadriceps and hamstring strength with a dynamometer or a standard protocol, and compare the operated leg with the other. A limb symmetry index of at least 90 percent is a common target. || Taaqat naapein

steps.title: Test hopping and movement
steps.detail: Use single hop, triple hop, crossover hop and timed hop, and check landing quality (knee falling inwards, trunk lean). A symmetry of at least 90 percent with good form is expected. || Hopping aur harkat test karein

steps.title: Check the mind and the clock
steps.detail: Ask about confidence and fear with a tool such as the ACL-RSI, and keep return to pivoting sport until at least nine months. Agree the plan with the surgeon, coach and athlete. || Zehen aur waqt dekhein

question.en: Which factor lowers the risk of a second ACL injury after reconstruction?
question.ur: ACL reconstruction ke baad doosri ACL chot ka khatra kaun si cheez kam karti hai?

text.en: Returning at six months for everyone
text.ur: Sab ke liye chhe mahine mein wapsi

feedback.en: Time alone is not a criterion.

text.en: Delaying return to pivoting sport and meeting strength and hop criteria
text.ur: Pivoting khel par wapsi mein takheer aur strength aur hop mayaar poore karna

feedback.en: Yes — each month of delay and each criterion met lowers the risk.
feedback.ur: Haan — har mahine ki takheer aur har mayaar poora karna khatra kam karta hai.

text.en: Returning as soon as the knee stops hurting
text.ur: Jaise hi knee ka dard khatam ho wapas aa jana

feedback.en: Pain-free is not the same as ready.
feedback.ur: Dard na hona taiyar hone ke barabar nahi.

title.ur: Waqt par mabni ya mayaar par mabni wapsi?

rows.en: Strength, hop tests, movement quality, readiness and time
rows.ur: Taaqat, hop tests, movement quality, taiyari aur waqt

rows.en: Ignores whether the knee is ready
rows.ur: Yeh nahi dekhta ke knee taiyar hai ya nahi

rows.en: Needs good testing and more clinic visits
rows.ur: Achhi testing aur zyada visits chahiye

text.en: **Nine months, ninety percent.** A common rule of thumb: at least nine months, 90 percent limb symmetry in strength and hopping, good movement quality and confidence. All together, not one by one.
text.ur: **Nau mahine, nabbe percent.** Aam usool: kam az kam nau mahine, taaqat aur hopping mein 90 percent limb symmetry, achhi movement quality aur aitemad. Sab ek saath, ek ek nahi.

text.en: **Using the uninjured leg as a perfect standard.** After injury, the "good" leg also loses fitness. Compare with pre-injury data when you have it, and look for a quality of movement, not only a percentage.
text.ur: **Be-chot taang ko mukammal mayaar samajhna.** Chot ke baad "achhi" taang ki fitness bhi kam ho jati hai. Jab ho to chot se pehle ke data se muqabla karein, aur sirf percentage nahi harkat ki quality dekhein.

question.en: An athlete has 95 percent hop symmetry and 80 percent quadriceps strength at eight months. What is the best decision?
question.ur: Khilari ke paas aath mahine par 95 percent hop symmetry aur 80 percent quadriceps taaqat hai. Behtareen faisla kya hai?

feedback.en: Return is possible once criteria are met.
feedback.ur: Mayaar poore hone par wapsi mumkin hai.

text.en: Continue strengthening and retest before returning to pivoting sport
text.ur: Strengthening jaari rakhein aur pivoting khel par wapsi se pehle dobara test karein

feedback.en: Yes — quadriceps strength is below the target; keep training.
feedback.ur: Haan — quadriceps ki taaqat maqsad se kam hai; training jaari rakhein.

text.en: Clear for full return because the hop result is good
text.ur: Hop result achha hone par mukammal wapsi

feedback.ur: Sab mayaar ahem hain, ek nahi.

question.en: Why is psychological readiness part of the criteria?
question.ur: Psychological readiness mayaar ka hissa kyun hai?

text.en: Fear and low confidence are linked to poorer return and re-injury
text.ur: Dar aur kam aitemad kamzor wapsi aur dobara chot se jura hai

feedback.en: Yes — readiness predicts return to sport.
feedback.ur: Haan — taiyari khel par wapsi ki peshgoi karti hai.

text.ur: Yeh performance par asar nahi daalti

feedback.ur: Studies dikhati hain ke daalti hai.

text.ur: Yeh sirf professionals ke liye hai

feedback.ur: Sab khilari mutasir ho sakte hain.

text.en: **Test, teach, repeat.** Share the test results and the plan with the athlete in simple numbers, such as "your quadriceps is at 82 percent; the goal is 90". Retest every four to six weeks. Keep strength work for years, not only the months of rehab.
text.ur: **Test, sikhayein, dohrayein.** Test ke nateeje aur plan khilari ko saade numbers mein batayein, maslan "aap ka quadriceps 82 percent par hai; maqsad 90 hai". Har chaar se chhe haftay baad dobara test karein. Strength ka kaam saalon jaari rakhein, sirf rehab ke mahinon tak nahi.

question.en: Why does waiting longer reduce the risk of another ACL injury?
question.ur: Zyada intezaar doosri ACL chot ka khatra kam kyun karta hai?

answer.en: Because the graft keeps maturing, the athlete has time to regain strength, power and control, and the brain relearns the movement patterns. Studies found a lower re-injury risk for each month of delay up to about nine months, and for those who met strength and hop criteria.
answer.ur: Kyunke graft pukhta hota rehta hai, khilari ko taaqat, power aur control wapas lene ka waqt milta hai, aur dimagh harkat ke pattern dobara seekhta hai. Studies mein takreeban nau mahine tak har mahine ki takheer par dobara chot ka khatra kam mila, aur un mein bhi jo strength aur hop mayaar poore karte thay.

beats.patient: A 21-year-old footballer, seven months after an ACL reconstruction, feels ready and wants to play next week. His quadriceps is at 78 percent, single hop at 92 percent, he lands with the knee falling inwards and his readiness score is low.
beats.assessment: Several criteria are not met: strength is low, landing control is poor, confidence is not yet high and nine months have not passed.
beats.treatment: Explain the evidence, continue strength and landing-control training, add controlled sport drills and retest in six weeks.
beats.reassess: At nine months his strength is 91 percent, landing is controlled and confidence is higher; he returns step by step.

text.en: **Hold return and refer** for a knee that swells, locks or gives way, pain at night, sudden loss of range, signs of infection (hot, red, fever), or a calf that is hot and swollen. Do not progress to pivoting sport while the knee is swollen or the quadriceps cannot control the knee.
text.ur: **Wapsi rokein aur refer karein** knee ka sujna, lock hona ya jawab dena, raat ka dard, range ka achanak kam hona, infection ki nishaniyan (garam, surkh, bukhar), ya garam soojhi hui pindli. Jab tak knee soojha ho ya quadriceps knee ko control na kar sake pivoting khel tak na barhein.

summary.en: Return to sport is a process (participation, sport, performance) decided by criteria, not the calendar.
summary.ur: Return to sport ek amal hai (hissa lena, khel, performance) jo mayaar se tay hota hai, tareekh se nahi.

summary.en: Use at least nine months, 90 percent limb symmetry in strength and hopping, good movement quality and psychological readiness together.
summary.ur: Kam az kam nau mahine, taaqat aur hopping mein 90 percent limb symmetry, achhi movement quality aur psychological readiness ek saath istemal karein.

summary.en: Retest every four to six weeks, explain results in simple numbers and keep strength training for years.
summary.ur: Har chaar se chhe haftay dobara test karein, nateeje saade numbers mein samjhayein aur strength training saalon jaari rakhein.

front.ur: Return to sport ke teen marhale kaun se hain?

back.en: Return to participation, return to sport and return to performance.
back.ur: Hissa lena, khel aur performance par wapsi.

front.en: What limb symmetry target is common?
front.ur: Limb symmetry ka aam maqsad kya hai?

back.en: At least 90 percent in strength and hop tests.
back.ur: Strength aur hop tests mein kam az kam 90 percent.

front.en: Why not return at a set date?
front.ur: Muqarrar tareekh par wapsi kyun nahi?

back.en: Readiness varies; criteria predict risk better than time alone.
back.ur: Taiyari mukhtalif hoti hai; mayaar khatre ki behtar peshgoi karte hain.
